software_correction: M6 now emits explicit grade_lower and grade_upper endpoint runs and includes grade_rad in every seeded joint design-sensitivity sample. The registered grade endpoints are equal; no new perturbation range or physical value is introduced.

M3.criterion: Tcrit minus 50 K, 10 K, and 2 K, frozen before execution

M6.sampling: seeded independent uniform design sampling within registered endpoints; not a physical probability distribution
M6.grade_endpoint_semantics: The literature registry resolves both grade endpoints to -0.09966865249116204 rad. Both labeled endpoint runs are retained to make coverage explicit without inventing a range.

claim_rules.C1: SUPPORTED only if dual feasible count exceeds friction-only and dual reserve is never smaller at matched points
claim_rules.C2: SUPPORTED only if allocation changes and peak-temperature spread is at least 1 K; otherwise PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED
claim_rules.C3: SUPPORTED only for positive warning time before an observed instantaneous crossing; negative predictive reserve alone is inconclusive
claim_rules.C4: SUPPORTED only with nonzero useful agreement and no missed triggers in every frozen channel case
claim_rules.C5: SUPPORTED only if every registered deterministic and joint sensitivity run avoids hard certificate loss
claim_rules.C6: SUPPORTED only if max G2 and max Ginf are at most 1 in every tested case
claim_rules.C7: SUPPORTED only if P99 total controller time is below 0.1 s for every tested N on the reported platform
